name: Thrud
source:
A new Valkyrie. Daughter of Thor, the God of thunder. She became a Valkyrie at the behest of her reluctant father, Thor. She was born a god, but she is still unable to wield her power fully.

She is always full of energy, She says, “I'll do my best,” but then screws up. Hildr is her commander, she looks at Hildr with honest admiration.

Rota is the closest to her ideal Valkyrie, she blindly respects and admires her. Deep down, she wants to like herself.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150504091526/http://www.matsuri-kikaku.com/matsuri/val2/val2_cha3.html]archived official site[/url]]
